source: Archives of American Art, Smithsonian Institution
methodology: All 532 HEIC images converted to thumbnails, reviewed via contact sheets (6x5 grids) and individual inspection. High-value candidates verified at full resolution. Selection prioritized cipher/keyword evidence, steganographic evidence, primary source documents, and production materials with direct Kryptos relevance.
